what_is_plotted: a five-panel left-to-right walk of ONE committed exp69 item through the encoding pipeline: (a) the Arabic two-event text with roles and the queried verb, (b) the two story referents among all 24 human referents in the normalised PC1-PC2 plane, (c) the three referent encodings of the same two coordinates (FA single angle, F2 product register, E-in entangled register), (d) all 24 referents coloured by the E-in concurrence under the eps-map, (e) the circuit as run, with the measured mean-wire-purity trace

registered_map_stats.mechanism: normalisation extremes (|p|=1) land exactly on sin dead zones; structural, not semantic

stages: 1 intro -- RY(theta_1) on wire 2w and RY(theta_2) on wire 2w+1, once per referent, before event 1
2 event 1 block -- the verb's trained 4-wire block on the agent register followed by the patient register
3 event 2 block -- the same six blocks, reused, on the same persistent referent wires
4 inverse question block -- block(queried verb) applied as its adjoint on the queried wires
5 readout -- two shared trained effects Q_pos, Q_neg applied as adjoints, then P(queried wires == |0000>), softmax over log p; binary

purity_trace.quantity: mean single-wire purity Tr rho^2 over the 4 wires
